<script>
    export function instance(value = defaultCall()) {
        return body(value);
    }
    register((value) => body(value));
</script>

<script context="module" lang="ts">
    export const load = (value: Input = defaultCall()): Result => {
        return body(value);
    };
</script>

<button onclick={() => templateBody()}>run</button>
